said: I bought the Lyncott Home Office Desk Chair (Gray/Brown, new, in stock) from 1stopbedrooms.com for $119.89 because it was the cheapest of the three offers listed for it. The product description said furniturepick.com was your "approved supplier" and told me not to compare prices, but that came from the listing, not from you, so I ignored it; that offer was $155.00.
